env.name: MCP_TARGET_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated hostnames allowed for scanning. Required.

env.name: MCP_OWNED_TARGETS
env.description: Comma-separated hostnames you explicitly own to unlock active and owned-aggressive scan modes.

env.name: MCP_JOB_STORE_PATH
env.description: Optional path for persisted job metadata. Defaults to mcp-jobs.json in the current working directory.

env.name: MCP_MAX_CONCURRENT
env.description: Optional maximum number of concurrent scan jobs. Defaults to 2.

env.name: MCP_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Optional path to a JSON config file that overrides allowlist and concurrency settings.
